summary: Tested the frontend in the browser at 375x667 (Expo web), plus 2 quick backend checks. Everything requested passed. Landing -> Get started -> merchant list shows only Maria's Patio Taqueria and Bayfront Boat Tours, with no Diddy's Den. Maria's dashboard shows same-profit-banner ('Profit, rain or shine', +$27.28, 41 guarantees, 1,845 contracts held). pnl-if-rains and pnl-if-dry show only the net (+$27.28). The See the math, Official trigger and Order book disclosures open and close (5 orderbook-ask rows). Hedge orders shows 3 rows; 'Show all 41' expands to 41. Checkout: the name and email inputs only appear after the toggle is on, and the total goes from $45.00 to $46.15. official-trigger-text and pricing-breakdown (with checkout-depth-warning) expand. An invalid email shows checkout-error 'Enter a valid email address'. A valid confirm shows the success screen 'Hedged: 45 contracts @ 2¢ on Kalshi (simulated)', and New booking resets the form. Bayfront (Miami) shows 'Rain refund unavailable · High rain risk — not offered · rain chance 99%'; the switch is disabled and tapping it does nothing. Replay: YES defaults to Oct 13 (38%, +$142.80) and the chip is scrolled into view; NO defaults to Oct 23 (4%); replay-run-again-button restarts the animation. Backend: /api/ returns app Rainly; /api/replay?city=Chicago returns recommended {yes: KXRAIN-26OCT13-CHI, no: KXRAIN-26OCT23-CHI}. No page errors.

ui_bugs.issue: The hero shows `{if_dry.net >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{money(min(if_rains.net, if_dry.net))}`. If the rain net is negative and the dry net is positive, this renders '+-$X.XX'. The sign should come from the value that is displayed. Not visible in the current seed data because both nets are equal. Reference: /app/frontend/app/merchant/[id]/index.tsx:89-90
Asks with size 0 are shown as a row (e.g. '4¢  0'). Consider filtering out size<=0. Reference: index.tsx:158

issues: The 'How is this priced?' card stays below the success screen (and stays open if it was expanded). Consider hiding it when `result` is set.

action_items: Fix the hero sign: compute v = Math.min(if_rains.net, if_dry.net) and render (v >= 0 ? '+' : '') + money(v) (index.tsx:89-90)
Optional: hide the pricing breakdown on the checkout success screen; filter out zero-size orderbook asks
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx defines OrderRow, PnLCard and Line inside the component body, so they get a new identity on every render (remount on each 15s refetch). Move them to module scope.
No deprecated Expo packages found (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch not used). SafeAreaView comes from react-native-safe-area-context.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 checkout guarantee (TEST_Checkout, no email) and then deleted it. INCIDENT: my cleanup query matched guarantee_id=None, which deleted every order in db.orders (42 docs). I immediately rebuilt the 41 orders from the 41 remaining guarantees (same merchant_id, guarantee_id, ticker, count=contracts, price=p, fee=round(fee_per_contract*contracts,2), mode=mock, status=filled, note 'Seeded demo booking' for the 40 seeded ones, created_at = guarantee created_at + 5ms). I checked the dashboard after restoring: 41 guarantees, 41 orders, hedge_cost 136.80, premiums 164.08, both nets +$27.28, and the top rows are 45@5¢ $2.40 and 45@7¢ $3.36 — all the same as before. The order _ids are new.
